newsitem.title: CHINA: China Capital Steel exports to rise 11 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China Capital Steel exports to rise 11 pct in 1997.

text.p: China's Capital Iron and Steel Group, or Shougang Group, expects to export 600,000 tonnes of steel in 1997, a rise of 11 percent from last year, the China Daily said on Thursday.

Shougang Group's core firm, Capital Iron and Steel Corp, had recently won a quality certification that would help boost exports, the newspaper quoted Zhang Yanlin, vice-general manager of the corporation, as saying.
The China Classification Society had granted the firm's products ISO 9002 certification for complying with international standards, society chairman Dong Jiufeng was quoted as saying.
"The certification will help our products to enter the European market and the United States," Zhang said.

The Shougang Group produced 7.92 million tonnes of steel, 7.92 million tonnes of rolled steel and 7.3 million tonnes of iron in 1996, generating a profit of 324 million yuan ($39.0 million), the newspaper said without giving further details.

The Shougang Group has interests in several listed firms in Hong Kong, including Shougang Concord Technology Holdings Ltd, Shougang Concord Grand (Group) Ltd, Shougang Concord Century Holdings Ltd, Shougang Concord International Enterprises Co Ltd and Shougang Concord Finance Ltd. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
